annotations.title: Rig for an amp or a song

description: Where to find an exact amp and what it takes: marketplace and retailer search links, live listings when available, the tubes it uses (with a matched pair for the power tubes), parts and kits for restoring or building one, and the modelers that have a Gridleak preset for it. Given an artist, a song or a tone, returns the whole rig: up to three amps from Gridleak's Heard-on credits (for a tone: an artist's credits, an amp named exactly, or amps whose records carry the tone's words, each labelled), the preset for the chosen modeler with its install link and settings, the tubes, and where to find each. Guitars, pedals and cabinets are not covered. Modelers: quadcortex, axefx2, axefx3, fm3, fm9, helix, or a modeler name such as 'HX Stomp' or 'Quad Cortex'.

amp.description: A catalog id ('marshall/jcm800_2204'), an amp name ('Dual Rectifier') or a factory model name ('Brit 2204').

artist.description: An artist or band, e.g. 'Alice In Chains'.

modeler.description: Optional: a device id (quadcortex, axefx2, axefx3, fm3, fm9, helix) or a modeler name ('HX Stomp', 'Quad Cortex').

tone.description: A tone in plain words or an artist's name, e.g. 'high-gain british'. Give an amp, an artist, a song or a tone.
